# Thunderbird Calendar browser and unit-test maintenance

Put direct `queueCalendarEventEdit` tests, which use synthetic identities and no providers, in standalone `test_calendarEventEditQueue.js` and register it in `xpcshell.toml`; put reducer-only row-default/dirty-state coverage in `test_calendarEventCreateEditState.js`. Extract helpers for calendar selection, commit, paused save, and move recovery, but have the save helper commit with `event.calendar` to retain move semantics. [Task 2]

Scope: calendar.
